theme: High-frequency sweep: conversation-glue lemmas, social nouns, and stem/ending cleanup

아닌.reason: Attributive form of 아니다 (to not be). The copular negative 아니다 is NOT in the curated core — flagged as a high-value future candidate; this form never becomes a row.

역시.reason: Adverb 'as expected / likewise / after all' — standalone dictionary lemma, very frequent in conversation, not curated; safe elective candidate.

위해서.reason: Grammar-only purpose construction ~을/를 위해서; same family as 위해/위한 (deferred in r1-r344).

버리.reason: Truncated stem of 버리다 (to throw away; auxiliary -아/어 버리다 'completely'). Lemma uncurated — flagged as a future candidate with its auxiliary use noted; fragment never a row.

그래도.reason: Conjunctive adverb 'even so / still' — lexicalized standalone dictionary lemma, core conversation glue, not curated; safe elective candidate.

이게.reason: Contraction of 이것 + subject particle 이; fully covered by curated 이것/이거. Teach as a spoken form on the existing row.

힘들.reason: Truncated stem of 힘들다 (to be hard/tiring). The lemma is NOT curated — flagged as a high-value future candidate; fragment never a row.

구나.reason: Grammar-only exclamatory ending -구나; grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

대해서.reason: Grammar-only ~에 대해서 (about/regarding); same family as 대해/대한 (deferred in r1-r344).

그런데.reason: Conjunction 'but / by the way' — standalone dictionary lemma and the parent of colloquial 근데 (merged onto it in r1-r344); core conversation glue, not curated.

그래.reason: Interjection 'yeah / right / really?' — dictionary lemma (감탄사) and essential conversational responder; intimate register, so the authored row must carry a register note.

관한.reason: Grammar-only attributive ~에 관한 (concerning, from 관하다); written-register grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

로부터.reason: Particle ~(으)로부터 (from); particles are excluded from vocabulary rows.
